<noinclude><!--
-=============================================================
- Float_box - Float as a box (alongside an infobox or image)
-=============================================================
-                        (see NOTES at bottom)
--></noinclude><table cellpadding=0 cellspacing={{{cellspacing|1}}}
  style="float:right; background:transparent; margin: {{{margins|0 0 0 0}}}; {{{style|}}}">
<tr><td>{{{1<includeonly>|<font color="#FF7711">'''ERROR: Missing parameter 1 in</font> [[Template:Float_box|Float_box]]'''.</includeonly>}}}</td>
</tr></table><noinclude><!--
--------------------------------------------------------------
--NOTES
--
-- NOTE A1: This template uses the CSS style="float:right" to
--      float a table containing the entire contents of what
--      is passed in parameter {1}. The template is designed to
--      automatically align with images on the same line.
--
-- NOTE P2: The parameters include:
--      style=xxxx - to include additional style options
--      margins=1px 2px 3px 4px - to set margins around the area
--
--------------------------------------------------------------
--HISTORY:
--22Jun2012 Created to float multiple images or link-boxes.
--
-->
{{Documentation}}
</noinclude>
